description: Divisional Secretariat Mahiyanganaya - Esala Festival of Mahiyanganaya - 2022
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the regulation of a religious festival (Mahiyangana Esala Festival), including camp area demarcation, permitted commercial activities, vehicle parking, and public health measures. It is issued by a Divisional Secretary under the Pilgrimages Ordinance and deals with temporary administrative arrangements for a specific event. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it pertains to cultural/religious event management rather than land, legal, commercial, electoral, public service, or judicial matters.
